chapter_note: This introductory unit begins with a compact cosmogonic survey (eternal separation, assault of Darkness, First Man, Living Spirit’s construction, Third Ambassador, final fire and binding) in an impersonal, cosmological voice—likely preserving the oldest teaching substrate. After this, the register pivots sharply into self-authorization (Mani’s books), institutional/audience address, and comparative-apostolic polemic (Jesus/Zarathustra/Buddha), with strong late pastoral/application drift and a detected editorial extension.

Seam-flagged institutional extension: disciples commanded to write; explicit community categories (‘teachers’, ‘leaders’, ‘elect’, ‘catechumens’, ‘free men/women’) and retrospective collection of homilies—editorial church-operational material.
Pure imperative/application voice (‘You must remember… write… gather…’) with no cosmological mechanism—pastoral exhortation.
Community-tier instruction and institutional categories (‘elect’, ‘suckling babes’) plus rhetorical self-reporting; not cosmos→cosmos mapping, but pastoral/adaptive teaching claims.
Ecclesial and apostolic discourse (‘apostles’, ‘fathers’, ‘church’) with application markers (‘Concerning this…’) and mission geography—late institutional reflection rather than core cosmology.
Explicit Jesus-historical narrative (west; disciples writing parables, signs, wonders) enters via Christian tradition/NT-world biography—classified as Christian overlay.
Hagiographic-comparative prophet material (‘apostle of light… Persia… Hystaspes… Zarathustra… they read today’) used to justify writing/authority; not impersonal cosmological teaching.
Comparative-apostolic narrative about Buddha and his churches/scriptures serves the same canonical justification theme; late framing rhetoric.
Polemic about institutional decay/adulteration when teachings aren’t written; focuses on ‘church’ persistence and leadership failure—pastoral-institutional argumentation.
Commands/commandments + exhortation to write after the speaker ‘so that it leads you not astray’—application voice and community safeguarding, not core cosmology.
Direct audience address and imperative (‘remember! And write…’) about recording oral wisdom—late pastoral instruction justifying the compilation.
Concluding encouragement about benefits of writing; practical exhortation, not cosmological exposition.
